usage: python -m textstats [-h] [--keep-bom] [--lines START:END] INPUT

Count lines and words in a UTF-8 file or stdin.

positional arguments:
  INPUT              named UTF-8 file, or - for binary UTF-8 stdin

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --keep-bom         retain the leading UTF-8 BOM
  --lines START:END  select one-based inclusive lines; count the available
                     subset at EOF

limits: Real temporary literal filename; explicit PYTHONPATH resolves current checkout. Distribution isolation is separately verified by consumer suite.
